children: NANOVIRICIDES, INC. reported fiscal 2026 results in its 10-K showing no revenue for the year and a net loss of $8.22M, an improvement from a $9.47M loss in FY 2025; diluted loss per share was $0.41 in FY 2026 versus $0.63 in FY 2025.
Revenue was $0 for FY 2026 and FY 2025 (company reports no revenues for both years).
Net loss was $8.22M in FY 2026, compared with a net loss of $9.47M in FY 2025 (≈$1.25M improvement).
Diluted earnings per share (loss) was ($0.41) for FY 2026 versus ($0.63) for FY 2025.
Clinical development: Advancing NV-387 through Phase II trials targeting MPox, Ebola, viral ARI/SARI and measles, with multiple interim datasets planned.
R&D focus and spend: Consolidated R&D efforts across indications; FY 2026 R&D expense was $4.7M, with major spend shifted to MPox/smallpox programs.
Regulatory and IP: Holds broad exclusive TheraCour licenses across numerous viruses and is pursuing orphan designations, IND/CTA filings and international approvals.
Financing and liquidity: Management raised capital via ATM and registered direct offerings to fund operations and is actively seeking non-dilutive grants and partnerships to support development.
